crossRefs.note: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.
Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received…

neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

“Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
“Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
preaching God’s Kingdom, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

translations.web: Heal the sick who are there, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
